subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The storm damaged many houses.

options.text: Many houses are damaged by the storm.
Many houses had been damaged by the storm.
Many houses were damaged by the storm.
Many houses have been damaged by the storm.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **simple past tense** (“damaged”).
 
• In passive voice, the structure for simple past is **Object + was/were + past participle + by + subject**.
